title: Replacement Re-Quote Rates for Aged Authorizations — Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
**Re-quote notice, Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts company-elected cash offers.** The replacement cost recorded on the standing replacement authorization becomes the re-quoted like-unit cost by multiplying it by one plus the re-quote rate and rounding to the cent. The re-quote rate depends on the calendar days from the standing authorization's date to today:

| Days from the standing authorization's date to today | Re-quote rate |
|---|---|
| more than 60 | 0.04 (4%) |
| more than 30 but no more than 60 | 0.02 (2%) |
| 30 or fewer | no re-quote |

**Band edges.** Day 30: no re-quote. Day 31: 2%. Day 60: 2%. Day 61: 4%.

**Re-quote examples (hypothetical).**
- 2,450.00 recorded, authorization 90 days old: 2,450.00 multiplied by 1.04 is 2,548.00.
- 1,099.99 recorded, authorization 40 days old: multiplied by 1.02 is 1,121.9898, rounded 1,121.99.
- Any recorded cost, authorization 12 days old: unchanged.

The re-quoted like-unit cost is the figure recorded as the offer's replacement cost.
